On January 15th, Peter, Mei, Diego, and Diego's new addition, Noor, decided to change their regular AI project meeting from 2 PM to 1 PM at Caroline's Café, starting the next day. They also agreed to bring various items for the community garden, vegan street tacos, and sunflower seeds for stray animals. data.content: Talked to Noor at library around 2026-01-15 14:00

Noor: "Hey Leo, I've been thinking about our AI music project. Would you like to share your new violin piece at our meeting tomorrow at Caroline's Café, 3 PM? I'll bring some vegan tacos too."

Leo: "Sounds great, Noor! I'd love to perform and enjoy some tacos afterward. See you there!"

Noor: "Looking forward to it. By the way, have you heard about Andy's early morning sketching sessions at the park next Tuesday? He invited me and suggested we join you for some fresh air and inspiration."

Leo: "Oh, that sounds wonderful! I'd be happy to have you both join me. Let's make it 6 AM then. See you at the park!"
Talked to Andy at restaurant around 2026-01-15 15:00

Andy: Hey Leo, great running into you at the park! I was just sketching the sunrise and thought of our meetings at Caroline's. How about we continue our discussion on the AI project there next Tuesday at 3 PM?

Leo: Sounds perfect, Andy! I'm excited to share my latest violin piece with you. How about we make it a tradition to enjoy vegan street tacos at the park afterward? And, speaking of traditions, I accepted your invite for early morning sketching sessions, let's meet at the park next Tuesday at 6 AM.

Andy: That sounds fantastic! I'll see you then. And hey, I've been meaning to ask, would you be interested in joining the cat and community garden discussions at the park next Saturday at 2 PM?

Leo: I'd love to, Andy! I've always enjoyed helping out at the community garden. See you at the park next Tuesday and Saturday!
Talked to Andy at town_hall around 2026-01-15 22:00

Andy: Hey Leo, I didn't expect to run into you here at the town hall.

Leo: Surprise, Andy! I was just finishing up a gig when I saw the notice about our meeting at Caroline's Café. I'm looking forward to discussing our AI project.

Andy: Me too, let's make it a regular thing. How about we grab a coffee there tomorrow at 3 PM, same as our meeting?

Leo: Sounds perfect, Andy. See you there!
Talked to Diego at theater around 2026-01-16 04:00

Diego: Hey Leo, great running into you here. Looks like we've both got our hands full with the AI project and the musical collaboration. How about we meet next Tuesday at Caroline's Café, 3 PM sharp, to discuss our plans and possibly grab some street tacos?

Leo: That sounds perfect, Diego! I've been wanting to try those street tacos you keep talking about. See you there on Tuesday, then! Let's make some music together!
Talked to Samantha at market around 2026-01-16 05:00

Samantha: Hi Leo, I didn't expect to see you here so early. I was just grabbing some coffee before heading to the cafe.

Leo: Good morning Samantha! It seems we're both early birds today. Would you like to join me for a quick busk at the park? I could use some company.

Samantha: That sounds delightful. Let's meet at the park entrance at 5:30, then. I'll bring some seeds for the community garden if you don't mind waiting for me.

Leo: Perfect! I'll see you there, Samantha. Looking forward to it.
